unit: Oberheim Xpander (model XP-1), 1984-1988; panel print as on US units
source_image: private/xpander/docs/photos/reverb/103212593/103212593_0.jpg (Reverb listing 103212593, 5712 x 4284, iPhone 16 main camera; raw pixels upright, EXIF orientation ignored)
source_note: Frame and print from the master photo, corrected for lens/sag bowing (radial term fitted to 30 straight print lines and panel edges) and perspective, scaled by the pot board artwork in the service manual (A#51, IC pin pitch 0.1 in, each half of the foldout scaled by its own pin pitch). Buttons from 59 cap-face fits, mapped to plan positions with the measured cap parallax (hole edges check them to 0.2 mm). Knob centres from the PCB artwork. Rear jacks from the pot and processor board artwork. Cross-checks: the 0.65 in key pitch comes out at 16.48-16.55 mm; the printed rear-jack legends sit over the jacks within 1-2 mm. MAME oberheim_xpander.lay / xpander.cpp give the inventory, names, switch matrix and LED latches. Photos are reference only (see private/xpander/docs).
origin: top-left (rear-left) corner of the top view: rear end of the left wooden end-bell; x right, y towards the player (down on screen), measured along the sloping top

official_dimensions_mm.note: Oberheim gives none in the manuals; dealer listings give 33 x 12 x 6 in and 27-28 lb

accuracy: button and knob centres +-0.3 mm relative, +-0.5 mm absolute; printed legends, lines, boxes, knob symbols +-0.3 mm relative; LEDs +-0.4 mm; VFD windows +-0.3 mm, character grid +-0.5 mm; overall scale +-0.3 % (checked by the 0.65 in key pitch); end-bells, rails and other raised parts +-1.5 mm (parallax corrected with an estimated height); 3-D sizes (cap height, knob height) estimates +-1-3 mm; rear +-1-2 mm

fonts.family: All panel print is one condensed grotesque, Helvetica Condensed (Medium for most legends, a lighter weight for the large titles): spurred G, straight-legged R, flagged 1, narrow round O. Open stand-in: Liberation Sans Narrow (SIL OFL 1.1, Arial/Helvetica Narrow metrics), Regular and Bold; Roboto Condensed is a second choice. Michroma (wide, extended) does not match. Fit each legend to its measured bbox width.
fonts.title: section titles (MASTER, PROGRAMMER, MODULATION SOURCE/X SELECT, PAGE MODIFIER, SINGLE/MULTI PATCH PAGE SELECT): cap height 7.0 mm, regular weight, white (MULTI grey)
fonts.page: page names next to the page buttons (VCO1 TRANS ...): cap 4.7 mm; first word white, alternate name grey
fonts.legend: large legends (VOLUME, TUNE PAGE, MASTER PAGE, SINGLE/PATCH, PATCH EDIT, STORE, SWITCH MODE, PAGE 2): cap 4.8 mm
fonts.legend_m: MODULATION SOURCE SELECT, X SELECT (cap 4.8 mm) and the X SELECT numerals under the mod buttons and encoders (cap 3.3-4.2 mm)
fonts.legend_s: small legends (VFD1 header, mod-source names, QUANTIZE, CLEAR): cap 2.5-2.7 mm
fonts.legend_xs: smallest side legends (MODULATION PAGE, MULTI PATCH PAGE, ON/OFF, VALUE X, MODULATION/PAGE SELECT): cap 2.4-2.5 mm
fonts.strip: rear-jack legends printed along the rear of the top panel: cap 3.0-3.2 mm
fonts.strip_head: their group headings (AUDIO OUT, CV AND GATE INPUTS, MIDI): cap 4.8-5.2 mm, with rules either side
fonts.box: labels inside the diagram boxes (VCO1, MIX, VCA, MULTIMODE VCF ...): cap 4.2-4.3 mm, white; PWM 3.3 mm (box_s)
fonts.diagram: diagram parameter labels (FREQUENCY, DETUNE ...) and the green modulation labels: cap 2.2-2.4 mm
fonts.keycap: numerals on the keypad caps: a bold rounded-geometric sans (DIN-like), cap 6.4 mm, white; stand-in Liberation Sans Narrow Bold or DIN Alternate-style OFL faces
fonts.vfd: not a font: draw 14-segment glyphs (+DP, +underline) in the character grid of each vfd element; the firmware holds the segment patterns
fonts.logos: Brand marks are not drawn: Oberheim and Xpander on the front, the emblem, wordmarks, address and serial label on the rear are artwork places.

conventions.text: bbox = ink box of the legend (cap height to baseline for caps; parentheses and descenders included); x,y = bbox centre; cap_h = capital height; align = how the legend sits relative to its control or line
conventions.line: points = stroke centre polyline; stroke = width (0.6 mm); colour key
conventions.outline_box: bbox = stroke centre line of the diagram box; stroke 0.6; square corners
conventions.fill: solid rectangle (blue bars and rules, panel area)
conventions.knob_symbol: printed knob in the page diagrams: circle radius r to the stroke centre, stroke width, pointer from r0 to r1 at deg (clockwise from 12 o'clock), numeral inside = the soft encoder that edits the parameter
conventions.button: x,y = cap/switch centre (plan position; caps stand ~3 mm proud); cap = visible cap top (square, rounded corners, concave dish); hole = square panel hole; matrix = MAME switch port (switches_N) and bit, active low
conventions.opening: shared black opening for a group of caps (no panel between the caps)
conventions.encoder: x,y = shaft centre; knob "xpander_skirted" (see knobs); encoder = index 0-5 left to right
conventions.knob: x,y = shaft centre; min/max_deg clockwise from 12 o'clock
conventions.led: x,y = centre; d = visible lens/hole, body_d = LED body; latch = output latch and bit (active low), mame_output = MAME output name
conventions.vfd: window = green filter cut-out; chars = 40-character grid (pitch, first character centre, cell size, slant); mame = MAME output names
conventions.logo: artwork place: a box the hardware view leaves for the user's artwork file (place name in "place")
conventions.frame: x,y in mm from the rear-left corner of the top view; nx = x/841.2, ny = y/312.5

ui_suggestions.note: Full top view 841.2 x 312.5 mm. At 1.6 px/mm it is 1346 x 500 px; the smallest legends (2.2 mm) are then ~3.5 px tall, so the plug-in wants 2 px/mm or more (1682 x 625) or a zoom. The print area alone is 813.7 x 272 mm.

Each VFD is 40 characters of 14-segment + DP + underline, driven as raw segment patterns by the main CPU (MAME outputs vfd_<n>_char_<i> as 16-bit segment masks). Draw unlit segments in vfd_unlit so the grid shows, as on the unit.
The knob symbols in the page diagrams carry the number of the soft encoder that edits that parameter on that page; they are print, not controls.
POWER and MEMORY PROTECT are on the rear only; the top panel has no power switch.
